capabilities: Import ChatGPT Markdown exports containing raw DIL tags, singly or in batches
Generate a companion note with interactive DIL components while preserving the original file
Render charts, sliders, number lines, graphs and equations offline in sandboxed iframes
Convert already-open notes to interactive versions via a command
Translate \[...\] and \(...\) equation delimiters into Obsidian math delimiters
disambiguation: Not a ChatGPT chat client or API integration; it only processes Markdown exports and never accesses your ChatGPT account.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.12.7+), mobile not supported; manual install or BRAT, and community directory submission is still pending; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: ChatGPT Markdown exports contain raw DIL tags that Obsidian shows as plain text, so the interactive diagrams, charts and controls they describe are lost.

relations.evidence: Compiler, Worker, DOM renderer, and base styles are adapted from Disdjj/intelligent-ui-demo
Import a Markdown export containing raw DIL tags, and the plugin creates a compatible companion note

summary: Imports ChatGPT Markdown exports containing raw DIL tags and renders their interactive diagrams, charts, controls and equations offline in Obsidian.
